title: Miraj Collective recap — Muslim founders retreat cites Incorruptible on 'Fortifying the Founder'
summary: Mikaeel Ahmed Smith recaps the Miraj Collective weekend — a retreat for Muslim founders — and frames the mission as 'Fortifying Founders': awakening them to their power and the global-change potential in their ambitious nature. Cites Incorruptible on the importance of being a fortified, principle-driven founder, and shares a video of Ashequl Hoque breaking down the core elements of being fortified.
blockquote: In his recent book Incorruptible, Eric Ries highlights the importance of being a fortified, principle driven founder.
attribution_title: Muslim founders retreat (recap by Mikaeel Ahmed Smith)
